description: This Java class 'CompileTool' provides a command-line utility to read a configuration or data file, process its lines possibly involving expression evaluation, and generate an output file with RPN (Reverse Polish Notation) conversions and macro definitions. It handles files related to the project, especially for pre-processing configuration scripts or similar data.

classes.name: CompileTool
classes.description: A utility class for converting expressions in a file into Reverse Polish Notation and generating associated macro definitions.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main entry point to execute the compilation process: reads input file, processes each line, writes output.

methods.name: handleOneFsioLine
methods.description: Processes a single line from the input file, converting expressions to RPN and formatting macro definitions.
